selection_semantics: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE ONLY. Prefix classification proposes candidates; it does not select paper inputs or authorize publication.

schema_notes.prefixes: Each key matches the first slash-separated component of a source key. Unknown prefixes receive review disposition.
schema_notes.disposition: candidate, review or exclude. Unsafe, credential and cache paths are excluded regardless of prefix rules.
schema_notes.release_root: Relative destination root; remaining source-key segments are reversibly percent-encoded.
schema_notes.component: User-defined component label for discovery and summary tables.

example-replays.reason: Invented replay prefix; actual scientific scope requires a separate selection policy

example-excluded.reason: Invented prefix outside the proposed scope; no source objects are deleted
